title: [SOLVED] Random hangs on Ryzen Mobile after 6.18.13 ?
body: Hello, first time posting here, sorry in advance if i missed anything in my post. I've been been running arch on this laptop since i got it in 2022, with a LUKS+BTRFS rootfs and a custom signed UKI . I'm using KDE Plasma as my DE in Wayland and SDDM as my DM. Since upgrading to anything newer than kernel 6.18.13 (i've tried : 6.19.6, 6.19.9, 6.18.19-lts, 6.18.20-lts), i'm seeing system hangs with most of the time no logs either in journalctl or dmesg. What i'm referring as "hangs" can be : - Black screen after unlocking LUKS with no cursor - Black screen after opening session with cursor - After being logged in for a bit, opening applications can take several minutes (every apps that i tried to open while it hangs will open all at once after some time) When it hangs, either it unblocks itself after a bit, or i have to hardware reset the computer since shutting it down gracefully result in a tty blocked saying the host is shutting down/rebooting now. I'm not sure where to start to diagnose this... I've tried solutions here but nothing seems to work. Reverting to 6.18.13 fix the issue completely. Are there others peoples with a similar issue or does someone have a clue onto what's going on? dracut config : hostonly="yes" use_fstab="yes" compress="zstd" add_drivers+=" amdgpu fat vfat " add_dracutmodules+=" plymouth " omit_dracutmodules+=" dmraid mdraid multipath cifs virtiofs " kernel_cmdline="rd.luks.uuid=luks-63d049e5-c71c-46e7-b0ba-2258cff511e4 rootfstype=btrfs rootflags=rw,relatime root=/dev/mapper/luks-63d049e5-c71c-46e7-b0ba-2258cff511e4 quiet splash vt.global_cursor_default=0 rcu_nocbs=0-11" uefi_secureboot_cert="/etc/efi-keys/db.crt" uefi_secureboot_key="/etc/efi-keys/db.key" Result of inxi -F : System: Host: nepgear Kernel: 6.18.13-arch1-1 arch: x86_64 bits: 64 Desktop: KDE Plasma v: 6.6.3 Distro: Arch Linux Machine: Type: Laptop System: LENOVO product: 21CFCTO1WW v: ThinkPad T14 Gen 3 serial: PF45AZ50 Mobo: LENOVO model: 21CFCTO1WW v: ThinkPad serial: <redacted> Firmware: UEFI vendor: LENOVO v: R23ET86W (1.62 ) date: 12/10/2025 Battery: ID-1: BAT0 charge: 27.8 Wh (54.2%) condition: 51.2/52.6 Wh (97.5%) CPU: Info: 6-core model: AMD Ryzen 5 PRO 6650U with Radeon Graphics bits: 64 type: MT MCP cache: L2: 3 MiB Speed (MHz): avg: 1319 min/max: 414/4586 cores: 1: 1319 2: 1319 3: 1319 4: 1319 5: 1319 6: 1319 7: 1319 8: 1319 9: 1319 10: 1319 11: 1319 12: 1319 Graphics: Device-1: Advanced Micro Devices [AMD/ATI] Rembrandt [Radeon 680M] driver: amdgpu v: kernel Device-2: Chicony Integrated Camera driver: uvcvideo type: USB Display: unspecified server: X.Org v: 24.1.9 with: Xwayland v: 24.1.9 driver: X: loaded: modesetting dri: radeonsi gpu: amdgpu resolution: 1920x1200~60Hz API: EGL v: 1.5 drivers: radeonsi,swrast platforms: gbm,x11,surfaceless,device API: OpenGL v: 4.6 compat-v: 4.5 vendor: amd mesa v: 26.0.3-arch1.1 renderer: AMD Radeon Graphics (radeonsi rembrandt ACO DRM 3.64 6.18.13-arch1-1) API: Vulkan Message: No Vulkan data available.
